body: Added --since N (minutes) filter to emily apples list. Fetches max(n,200) then filters by recorded_at > now-N*min. Created cmd/apples_test.go with 6 new tests covering unknownSubcommand, noSubcommand, list_noSecret, list_sinceFlag_parsesCleanly, get_badID, post_missingType. Test suite: 75 tests, all green.
title: feat: emily apples list --since N + apples_test.go (6 tests, total 75)
